normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you ever traveled to Europe?
options: A. Yes, I go there every day.
B. No, I am not in Europe.
C. I will travel next week.
D. Yes, I have been there twice.
normal.explain: 聽到「你曾經去過歐洲嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我去過兩次。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

C. The device is very expensive.

normal.explain: 聽到「如果設備壞了，你會修理它嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我明天會修理。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The new books have already been sold out.
options: A. We should buy some books.

normal.explain: 聽到「新書已經全部賣完了。」最適合回應「噢不，我們太晚了。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If you need a refund, you must bring the item back.
options: A. I don't want a refund.

normal.explain: 聽到「如果你需要退款，必須把物品帶回來。」最適合回答「好的，我會帶著它。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the final grade been announced?
options: A. The class is very interesting.

normal.explain: 聽到「最終成績公布了嗎？」最適合回答「還沒，我們還在等。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If your symptoms get worse, what will you do?
options: A. I will go back to the hospital.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you bought travel insurance for the trip?

normal.explain: 聽到「你買了這趟旅行的旅遊平安險了嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我昨天在網路上買了。」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The marketing strategy has been changed.

normal.explain: 聽到「行銷策略已經改變了。」最適合回應「真的嗎？新的計畫是什麼？」

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we offer a discount, will more people buy it?

normal.speak: Has the business proposal been approved by the investor?
options: A. Yes, they signed it this morning.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If you miss the flight, you will have to wait for the next one.
options: A. I am at the airport now.
B. I understand. I will run to the gate!
D. I have a lot of luggage.
normal.explain: 聽到「如果你錯過航班，就必須等下一班。」最適合回應「我了解，我會用跑的去登機門！」

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】I ___ that new science documentary recently. It is fascinating.
normal.explain: 主詞 I 搭配 have，且句尾有 recently（最近），需使用現在完成式 (have + V-p.p.)，表示從過去到現在的經驗或剛完成的動作。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】Mr. Lin ___ in the marketing department for five years.
normal.explain: 句子中有 for five years（持續五年），表示從過去一直持續到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成式 has worked。

normal.desc: 【時態】___ you ___ the final editing of the video yet?
normal.explain: 句尾有 yet，常用於現在完成式的疑問句或否定句，結構為 Have/Has + 主詞 + V-p.p.，因此選 Have / finished。

normal.desc: 【基礎文法】The tech firm ___ a new smartwatch that tracks your daily steps.
normal.explain: 句子缺乏主要動詞，且主詞為單數 The tech firm，根據語意表示「已經推出」，使用現在完成式 has launched 最合理。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ the official confirmation from the client yet, so please wait.
normal.explain: 句尾的 yet 提示現在完成式，表示「目前還沒有收到」，結構為 have not + V-p.p.，因此選 have not received。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you ___ the red button, the machine will shut down immediately.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句：If 條件子句用現在式代替未來式，主要子句用未來式 (will shut down)，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 press。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the weather ___ bad tomorrow, we will stay indoors and watch movies.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句中，If 子句即使表示未來發生的事，也必須使用現在式。主詞 the weather 為單數，故選 is。

normal.desc: 【條件句】We will give you a 10% discount if you ___ the premium plan today.
normal.explain: 此為第一類條件句，主要子句 (We will give...) 為未來式，if 子句須用現在式，主詞 you 搭配動詞 purchase。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If she ___ hard for the test, she will definitely get a high score.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句 If 子句用現在式，主詞 she 為第三人稱單數，動詞需加 s/es，因此選 studies。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the traffic ___ heavy, I will take the subway instead of driving.
normal.explain: traffic 為不可數名詞，視為單數，第一類條件句的 If 子句需用現在式單數動詞 is。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new museum ___ by a famous architect last year.
normal.explain: 主詞 museum 是被建造的，需用被動語態 (be + V-p.p.)。時間是 last year，所以用過去被動語態 was built。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】All the guest rooms in this hotel ___ perfectly every morning.
normal.explain: every morning 表示常態性動作，使用現在式。主詞 rooms 是複數且「被」打掃，需用現在被動語態 are cleaned。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】My wallet ___ while I was taking the bus to work.
normal.explain: 錢包是「被」偷，必須用被動語態，且動作發生在過去 (while I was taking...)，故選 was stolen。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The technical problem ___ by our IT team by tomorrow afternoon.
normal.explain: 時間點為 by tomorrow afternoon（明天下午之前），表示未來的動作，且問題是「被」解決，故選未來被動語態 will be solved。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】English ___ in many different countries around the world.
normal.explain: 這是一個陳述事實的句子，用現在式。英文是「被」說的，因此使用現在被動語態 is spoken。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A good marketing ___ is needed to attract more young customers to our store.
normal.explain: strategy 意思是「策略」，marketing strategy (行銷策略) 最符合語意。environment 是環境，commute 是通勤，destination 是目的地。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company made a huge ___ this year because of the popular new phone.
normal.explain: profit 意思是「利潤、收益」。make a profit 意為獲利，符合句子「因為受歡迎的新手機而賺取巨大收益」的語意。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Many people from the suburbs have to ___ to the city center for work every day.
normal.explain: commute 意為「通勤」。從郊區通勤到市中心上班符合邏輯。invest 為投資，install 為安裝，recover 為恢復。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Paris is a very popular tourist ___ for people who love art and history.
normal.explain: destination 意為「目的地」，tourist destination 表示「旅遊勝地」，符合巴黎作為熱門旅遊城市的描述。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If you have a fever or a bad cough, those are common ___ of the flu.
normal.explain: symptoms 意思是「症狀」。發燒和嚴重咳嗽是流感的常見症狀。refunds 退款，profits 利潤，environments 環境。

normal.desc: 【字彙】We must reduce plastic waste to protect our natural ___.
normal.explain: environment 意為「環境」。保護自然環境 (natural environment) 是減少塑膠垃圾的目的。warranty 保固，strategy 策略，commute 通勤。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Air ___ is becoming a serious problem in big cities with too many cars.
normal.explain: pollution 意為「污染」。air pollution (空氣污染) 在汽車過多的大城市日益嚴重。

normal.desc: 【字彙】This television comes with a two-year ___, so you can get it fixed for free if it breaks.
normal.explain: warranty 意為「保固」。根據後文「如果壞了可以免費維修」，可知這裡需要填入保固。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The item was broken when I opened the box, so I asked the store for a full ___.
normal.explain: refund 意為「退款」。因為商品收到時已經損壞，所以要求全額退款 (full refund) 最為合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If your computer is too slow, you might need to ___ the memory.
normal.explain: upgrade 意為「升級」。電腦太慢可能需要升級記憶體。commute 通勤，recover 恢復，pollute 污染。

normal.desc:
【短文】Please find the meeting notes attached. The design team has updated the UI graphics. If you need any further changes, please let me know before Friday. 
Question: What has the design team done?
options: A. They have canceled the meeting.
B. They have sent the notes.
C. They have updated the graphics.
D. They have requested further changes.
normal.explain: 信件中提到「The design team has updated the UI graphics.」，因此答案為 C。其他皆非設計團隊已完成的動作。

normal.desc:
【短文】Your flight to Tokyo has been delayed by two hours due to heavy rain. We will provide a meal voucher if you wait at the gate. 
Question: Why is the flight delayed?
options: C. Because of an engine problem.
D. Because there are too many passengers.
normal.explain: 告示提到「due to heavy rain」(由於大雨)，這屬於不良天氣狀況 (bad weather)，故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】If you are not 100% satisfied with your purchase, you can return it within 30 days. The shipping fee for returns will be paid by the customer. 
Question: Who pays for the return shipping?
normal.explain: 短文中明確指出「The shipping fee for returns will be paid by the customer.」，也就是由顧客來支付退貨運費。

normal.desc:
【短文】Eating a balanced diet has improved my sleep quality. If you want to feel more energetic, you should consume more vegetables and whole grains. 
Question: What is one benefit of a balanced diet mentioned here?
normal.explain: 文章開頭提到「Eating a balanced diet has improved my sleep quality.」，意即均衡飲食改善了睡眠品質，故選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】The software must be installed on your computer before you can use the editing tools. If the installation fails, please restart the system. 
Question: What should a user do if the software does not install correctly?
normal.explain: 文末提到「If the installation fails, please restart the system.」，因此若安裝失敗，使用者應重新啟動系統。

normal.desc:
【短文】The local library has been closed for repairs since last month. It will be opened to the public again on November 15th. 
Question: When will people be able to visit the library again?
normal.explain: 文中說明「It will be opened to the public again on November 15th.」，因此 11 月 15 日大眾可再次造訪。

normal.desc:
【短文】I have lived in London for three years. It is an amazing city, but if you do not like rainy days, you might feel a bit depressed here. 
Question: What might make someone feel depressed in London, according to the text?
options: C. Living there for three years
normal.explain: 作者提到「if you do not like rainy days, you might feel a bit depressed here」，意即下雨天可能會讓人感到有些憂鬱。

normal.desc:
【短文】Thank you for booking with Sunset Hotel. Your accommodation is confirmed. If you plan to arrive after 10 PM, please inform the front desk. 
Question: What should a guest do if they will arrive at 11 PM?
options: D. Go directly to their room.
normal.explain: 文中提到「If you plan to arrive after 10 PM, please inform the front desk.」，11 PM 晚於 10 PM，故需通知櫃檯。

normal.desc:
【短文】A new strategy has been developed to reduce plastic pollution in the ocean. The government will invest two million dollars in this project next year. 
Question: What is the goal of the new strategy?
options: A. To build a new ocean.
B. To invest in real estate.
normal.explain: 首句指出「A new strategy has been developed to reduce plastic pollution in the ocean.」，清楚說明目標是減少塑膠污染。

normal.desc: 【介系詞】She has been interested ___ web design since she was a university student.
normal.explain: be interested in 為固定用法，表示「對...感興趣」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you booked the flight to New York? 
B: No, not yet. I will do it ___ I finish this important task.
normal.explain: B 表示還沒訂機票，並說「我一完成這個重要任務就會去訂」。「as soon as」意為「一...就...」，引導時間副詞子句，符合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What happens if the machine breaks during the first year? 
B: Do not worry. It ___ by our technicians for free.
normal.explain: A 詢問未來發生的狀況，B 的回答應為未來式。且機器是「被」修理，需用未來被動語態 will be repaired。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The doctor advised him to eat foods rich in ___ to stay healthy and strong.
normal.explain: nutrients 意為「營養素」。醫生建議多吃富含營養素的食物以保持健康。symptoms 症狀，warranties 保固，pollutants 污染物。

【被動語態】A lot of plastic waste ___ from the ocean every year.
normal.explain: 主詞 plastic waste（塑膠垃圾）與動詞 remove（清除）是被動關係，且句尾 every year 表示常態事實，應使用現在簡單式的被動語態，故選 (A)。(B) 是主動，(C) 是完成式主動，(D) 是現在分詞皆不符。

normal.desc: 【字彙】We should always ___ glass bottles and paper to save natural resources.
normal.explain: 句意為「我們應該總是回收玻璃瓶和紙張以節省自然資源」。(B) recycle 回收最符合文意。(A) 浪費，(C) 打破，(D) 丟棄，皆不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【時態】The government ___ new rules for solar energy.
normal.explain: 本題測試現在完成式。單數主詞 The government 搭配 has + p.p. 表示近期已經完成的動作（已經宣布）。(A) 缺少 be 動詞，(B) 缺少 s，(D) 是被動語態，不合文法。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If we use less water daily, we ___ the natural environment.
normal.explain: 本題測試 If 第一類條件句。If 子句用現在簡單式 (use)，主要子句應搭配未來式 (will + 原形動詞)，表示未來會發生的結果。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The public park ___ by a group of local volunteers last weekend.
normal.explain: 主詞 The public park（公園）是被打掃的，且時間為 last weekend（上週末），故須使用過去簡單式的被動語態 was cleaned。選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The changing ___ has caused a lot of serious problems for farmers in the south.
normal.explain: 句意為「不斷改變的『氣候』給南方的農民帶來許多嚴重問題」。(B) climate 氣候最符合句意。(A) 習慣，(C) 營養，(D) 裝置，皆不合理。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: ___ you finished reading the article on global warming? 
B: Yes, I just read it this morning.
normal.explain: 問句中有過去分詞 finished，表示這是一個現在完成式的疑問句（Have you + p.p.?），詢問「是否已經完成某事」。故正確答案為 (C)。

normal.desc:
【短文】The city has built a new recycling center. If citizens bring their plastic bottles, they will get a small reward. 
Question: How can people get a reward?
options: A. By buying new plastic items.
B. By working at the center.
C. By cleaning the city streets.
normal.explain: 這是一篇關於環境政策的短文。根據「If citizens bring their plastic bottles, they will get a small reward.」可知，只要帶塑膠瓶來就能獲得獎勵。因此正確答案為 (D)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Solar energy is becoming more popular. A large solar farm was built in the desert last year. It has provided electricity to thousands of homes. 
Question: What has the solar farm done?
options: B. Brought rain to the desert.
C. Created new jobs for farmers.
normal.explain: 短文提到「It has provided electricity to thousands of homes.」（它已經提供電力給數千個家庭）。electricity 等同於 power，故選 (A)。

normal.desc:
【短文】We have decided to turn off the lights at night. If we do this, the office will save a lot of energy. 
Question: Why are they turning off the lights?
options: A. To fix a broken machine.
normal.explain: 短文指出「If we do this, the office will save a lot of energy.」（如果我們這麼做，辦公室將省下大量能源）。關燈的目的在於節省能源，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new smartphone ___ by millions of people already.
normal.explain: 主詞 The new smartphone 為單數，且與動詞 use（使用）是被動關係。選項中只有 (C) is used 是正確的單數被動型態。

normal.desc: 【字彙】You can connect this small smart ___ to your television to watch videos.
normal.explain: 句意為「你可以將這個小型的智慧『裝置』連接到電視上觀看影片」。(D) device 裝置最符合語境。(A) 氣候，(B) 能源，(C) 電池，皆不符合。

normal.desc: 【時態】Our tech team ___ a useful application for language learning.
normal.explain: 單數主詞 Our tech team 應搭配第三人稱單數動詞。句意為「已經創造出一個好用的應用程式」，故選 (A) 現在完成式 has created。(D) 被動語態與語意相反。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the battery dies, the screen ___ dark immediately.
normal.explain: 第一類條件句句型：If + 現代簡單式 (dies)，主要子句使用 未來式 (will + 原形動詞)。故選 (B) will go。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】All digital files ___ on a secure server to prevent any data loss.
normal.explain: 主詞 All digital files（所有數位檔案）為複數，與儲存 (store) 為被動關係，故應選 (C) are stored 表示常態事實的被動。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The best ___ of this new camera is its ability to take clear photos at night.
normal.explain: 句意為「這台新相機最棒的『特色』是能夠在夜間拍出清晰的照片」。(D) feature 特色/特徵 最為合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the website so slow? 
B: I think the system ___ by a computer virus.
normal.explain: 主詞 the system（系統）是被攻擊的，且表達「已經遭到攻擊」的狀態，必須用現在完成式的被動語態。故選 (A) has been attacked。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The weekly session ___ to Friday morning because the boss was busy.
normal.explain: 會議 (session) 是被移動的，且後半句時間為過去式 (was busy)，故應使用過去簡單式的被動語態，選 (A) was moved。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Many companies now allow ___ work, so people can work from their homes.
normal.explain: 句意為「許多公司現在允許『遠距』工作，所以人們可以在家上班」。(B) remote 遠距的/遙遠的 最符合句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】He ___ from home since the beginning of this year.
normal.explain: 句中有 since (自從...) 引導的時間副詞片語，主要子句應搭配現在完成式 (has + p.p.)，表示動作從過去持續到現在。故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you need help with the task, I ___ you an email later.
normal.explain: If 第一類條件句：If 搭配現在簡單式 (need)，主要子句使用未來式 (will + 原形動詞)。故選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Important company rules ___ on the information wall for everyone to see.
normal.explain: 主詞 rules（規則）是被張貼的，必須使用被動語態。(A) are posted 是唯一的被動語態選項。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Working in a quiet environment can increase your ___, allowing you to finish tasks faster.
normal.explain: 句意為「在安靜的環境工作能提升你的『生產力』，讓你能更快完成工作」。(B) productivity 最符合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you met the new team member? 
B: No, I ___ him yet because I was on vacation.
normal.explain: 問句使用現在完成式 (Have you met...)，且句尾有 yet (尚未)，回答時也應搭配現在完成式的否定型態。故選 (C) have not seen。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Fresh fruit and vegetables ___ in the local market every morning.
normal.explain: 主詞 fruit and vegetables（蔬果）與動詞 sell（販售）是被動關係，且句尾有 every morning 表示常態，故選 (C) are sold。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Good ___ is essential for children to grow up healthy and strong.
normal.explain: 句意為「良好的『營養』對孩子健康強壯地成長是必要的」。(D) nutrition 營養，最合乎句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】Scientists ___ a link between eating too much sugar and heart diseases.
normal.explain: 主詞 Scientists 為複數，句意表達「已經發現了關聯」。使用現在完成式主動語態 (have found) 最能強調此一研究成果與現在的關聯性。故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you eat too much fast food, you ___ weight quickly.
normal.explain: If 引導的第一類條件句，前面用現在簡單式 (eat)，後面主要子句要用未來式 (will + 原形動詞) 表示結果。故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new diet plan ___ by doctors for patients with high blood pressure.
normal.explain: 主詞 diet plan（飲食計畫）與 recommend（推薦）是被動關係，計畫「被推薦」，故選 (C) is recommended。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Drinking a glass of warm water every morning is a very good daily ___.
normal.explain: 句意為「每天早上喝一杯溫水是很好的日常『習慣』」。(D) habit 習慣，符合文意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Has she recovered from the bad cold? 
B: Yes, she ___ a lot of rest over the weekend.
normal.explain: 針對問句 Has she recovered... (現在完成式) 的回答，以及表達對現在有影響的近期動作，應對應使用現在完成式 (has taken)。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The old bridge ___ last year for safety reasons.
normal.explain: 主詞 bridge（橋樑）是被關閉的，且時間為 last year（去年），必須用過去簡單式的被動語態，選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ___ transportation in this big city is very convenient and cheap.
normal.explain: 句意為「這座大城市的『大眾』運輸非常方便且便宜」。public transportation 為固定名詞組合，意即大眾運輸。

normal.desc: 【時態】The mayor ___ several new parks in the city center recently.
normal.explain: 句尾有 recently（最近），通常搭配現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示最近完成的動作，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you take the subway, you ___ the traffic jam on the road.
normal.explain: If 子句使用現在式 (take)，主要子句應使用未來式 (will avoid) 來表達條件帶來的結果。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Street lights in this neighborhood ___ every evening at exactly six o'clock.
normal.explain: 主詞 Street lights（路燈）是被打開的，且 every evening 表示常態動作，故選現在簡單式的被動語態 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The bus driver took a different ___ today because of the road construction.
normal.explain: 句意為「因為道路施工，公車司機今天走了不同的『路線』」。(B) route 路線，符合語意。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have they finished repairing the road? 
B: No, the construction workers ___ there since Monday.
normal.explain: 句尾 since Monday（自從星期一）指示動作從過去一直延續到現在，必須使用現在完成式，故選 (C)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句為 accommodation，意思是「住宿」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句為 prescription，意思是「處方」或「處方箋」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句為 negotiate，意思是「談判」或「協商」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句為 scholarship，意思是「獎學金」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句為 evaluate，意思是「評估」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The performance will be evaluated next month.
options: A. 表現不好會被開除。
C. 這個月的表現很好。
D. 下個月將會評估工作表現。
boss.explain: 英文原句為 The performance will be evaluated next month. 意思是「下個月將會評估工作表現。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you do not take the medicine, the infection will not heal.
options: A. 如果你不吃藥，感染就不會痊癒。
B. 如果你吃藥，感染就會變嚴重。
C. 感染已經因為吃藥而痊癒了。
D. 你必須吃藥才能預防感染。
boss.explain: 英文原句為 If you do not take the medicine, the infection will not heal. 意思是「如果你不吃藥，感染就不會痊癒。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: My luggage has been lost at the airport.
options: A. 我在機場找到了行李。
B. 我的行李在機場遺失了。
C. 我忘記帶行李去機場。
D. 行李在機場被偷了。
boss.explain: 英文原句為 My luggage has been lost at the airport. 意思是「我的行李在機場遺失了。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you negotiated a better price for the accommodation?
options: A. I prefer to stay in a hotel.
C. Yes, I got a ten percent discount.
D. I haven't found a place to stay.
boss.explain: 聽到「你已經為住宿談判到更好的價格了嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我拿到了九折優惠。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you win the scholarship, which university will you choose?
options: A. The university is very famous.
B. I study hard every day.
C. I didn't win the competition.
boss.explain: 聽到「如果你贏得獎學金，你會選擇哪一所大學？」最適合回答「我還沒決定。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the doctor given you a prescription for your cough?
options: A. Yes, I need to go to the pharmacy.
B. The doctor is very professional.
C. My cough is getting worse.
D. I don't have a prescription.
boss.explain: 聽到「醫生已經給你治咳嗽的處方箋了嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我需要去一趟藥局。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the contract is broken, we will take legal action.
options: B. Let's hope they keep their promise.
C. The legal action is expensive.
D. We need to sign a new contract.
boss.explain: 聽到「如果合約被打破，我們將採取法律行動。」最適合回應「希望他們信守承諾。」

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】Not only ___ the new software installed successfully, but it has also increased our work efficiency by 20%.
boss.explain: Not only 置於句首時需倒裝。後半句有 installed (V-p.p.)，軟體是被安裝，需用被動語態的 be 動詞，且動作發生在過去，故選 was (was the new software installed)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】If the board members ___ to the proposed budget, we will start the construction next week.
boss.explain: 第一類條件句中，If 子句即使講述未來的決定，也必須使用現在式。主詞 the board members 為複數，動詞用原形 agree。

boss.desc:
【短文】A new study reveals that commuting for more than one hour daily has been linked to higher stress levels. Researchers suggest that companies offer flexible work hours. 
Question: What is the main finding of the study?
options: A. Commuting is cheap in the city.
B. Long commutes can increase stress.
C. Flexible hours cause lower productivity.
D. Researchers prefer to commute by train.
boss.explain: 文中指出「commuting for more than one hour daily has been linked to higher stress levels」(每天通勤超過一小時與較高壓力有關)，因此 B 是主要發現。

boss.desc:
【短文】To receive a full refund, the item must be returned in its original packaging within 14 days of purchase. Items that have been used or damaged will not be accepted. 
Question: Under what condition will a return NOT be accepted?
options: A. If it is returned within 7 days.
B. If it is in the original packaging.
C. If the item has been damaged.
D. If the customer asks for a refund.
boss.explain: 文中最後一句「Items that have been used or damaged will not be accepted.」明確指出損壞的物品不接受退貨，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Our team has been trying to find a better ___ to solve this complex engineering problem.
boss.explain: solution 意為「解決方案」，與後面的 solve this problem 呼應。destination 目的地，refund 退款，accommodation 住宿。

boss.desc:
【短文】The gallery has hosted several modern art exhibitions this year. If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events. 
Question: What is a benefit of the annual membership?
options: A. Free coffee at the museum cafe.
C. You can host your own exhibition.
boss.explain: 文中提到「If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events」，意即能受邀參加私人展館活動。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】The new environmental laws ___ by the government to reduce carbon emissions across the country.
boss.explain: 主詞 laws (法律) 是被引入的，需要被動語態，且搭配 recently 通常用現在完成式，故選 have been introduced 的現在完成被動式。

boss.desc: 【片語字彙】The CEO decided to ___ the new strategy instead of sticking to the old business model.
boss.explain: go ahead with 意為「推進、開始執行」。句意為執行新策略以取代舊模式。look forward to 期待，rely on 依賴，stay away from 遠離。

boss.desc:
【短文】Scientists have successfully developed a solar panel that works at night. This invention will significantly change how we use renewable energy. 
Question: What can be inferred about the new solar panel?
options: A. It requires a lot of water to work.
B. It only works when the sun is shining.
C. It generates power even when it is dark.
D. It is too expensive for most people.
boss.explain: 文章說「works at night」(在晚上運作)，這代表即使天黑也能產生能源，故選 C。infer(推論)的考法要求根據內文合理延伸。

boss.desc: 【時態】The financial report ___ to the investors by the time they arrive for the annual meeting tomorrow.
boss.explain: by the time 加上未來的時間點，常搭配未來完成式。報告是「被」寄出，需使用未來完成被動式 will have been sent。雖然難度稍微偏高，但為 B1 上層至 B2 的進階挑戰。

boss.desc:
【短文】As a loyal customer, you have been selected for a free upgrade to our premium internet service. If you accept this offer, your monthly speed will double without any extra charges. 
Question: What will happen if the customer accepts the offer?
options: A. They will have to pay double the price.
B. They will lose their internet connection.
C. Their internet speed will increase by 100%.
D. Their contract will be canceled.
boss.explain: 文中的「your monthly speed will double (速度將翻倍)」意思等同於速度增加 100%，故選 C。且沒有額外收費。

boss.desc: 【字彙】If you are experiencing severe ___, you should consult a medical professional immediately.
boss.explain: severe symptoms 意為「嚴重的症狀」。若經歷嚴重症狀應立即就醫。solutions 解決方案，nutrients 營養素，environments 環境。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：維護
請唸出單字：解決
請唸出單字：車輛
請唸出單字：升級
請唸出單字：製造
請唸出：例行維護
請唸出：解決衝突
請唸出：升級系統
請唸出：我們已經投資了新科技
boss.ans: WE HAVE INVESTED IN NEW TECHNOLOGY
boss.speak: we have invested in new technology

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果預算足夠我們將升級
boss.ans: IF THE BUDGET IS ENOUGH WE WILL UPGRADE
boss.speak: if the budget is enough we will upgrade

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項策略已經被證明有效
boss.ans: THE STRATEGY HAS BEEN PROVEN EFFECTIVE
boss.speak: the strategy has been proven effective

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果客訴沒解決我會離職
boss.ans: IF THE COMPLAINT IS NOT RESOLVED I WILL QUIT
boss.speak: if the complaint is not resolved i will quit

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ C O M M _ N _ (推薦)
請拼出：投訴
填空題：I _ V I T A _ I _ N (邀請)
填空題：E X C _ L L _ N _ (優秀的)
請拼出：滿意的
填空題：S _ T _ S F _ E D (滿意的)
請拼出：成功的
填空題：S U C _ E _ S F U _ (成功的)
請拼出：達成
填空題：A C H _ _ V _ (達成)
請拼出：指示
填空題：I N S T R _ C _ I O _ (指示)

【短文】The latest headphones have an active noise-canceling function. If you wear them on an airplane, you will not hear the engine sound. 
Question: What is a benefit of the headphones?
options: B. They block out engine noise.
C. They can play music louder.
D. They are easy to carry.
boss.explain: 短文指出戴上這款耳機「you will not hear the engine sound (你就不會聽到引擎聲)」，這表示它們能阻擋噪音，故選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A smart ring was introduced by a tech company last month. It can track your heart rate and sleep patterns. 
Question: What can the smart ring do?
boss.explain: 短文中提到它能「track your heart rate and sleep patterns (追蹤心率與睡眠模式)」，這些皆屬於健康數據 (health data)，故選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Traditional books are still loved by many. However, digital reading has become more common because tablets are easy to carry. 
Question: Why is reading on tablets common?
options: A. They are cheaper than books.
B. They are better for the eyes.
boss.explain: 短文提到平板閱讀變得普遍是因為「tablets are easy to carry (容易攜帶)」，portable 就是易於攜帶之意，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Remote work has changed our daily routines. If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family. 
Question: What is an advantage of not commuting?
boss.explain: 短文提到「If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family (如果不通勤，我們會有更多時間陪家人)」，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】The office layout was redesigned by a famous studio. They added more open spaces so people can talk to each other easily. 
Question: Why did they add open spaces?
options: C. To make the office look larger.
boss.explain: 短文說明增加開放空間是為了「so people can talk to each other easily (讓人們容易交談)」，即鼓勵溝通 (encourage communication)，選 (A)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Your primary task this week is to organize the customer files. If you finish early, please help the design team. 
Question: What should the person do if they complete their work early?
boss.explain: 文中指示「If you finish early, please help the design team (若提早完成，請協助設計團隊)」，Assist the designers 意思與此相符，選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A recent study shows that walking for thirty minutes a day improves heart health. If you exercise regularly, you will feel less tired. 
Question: How long should one walk daily according to the study?
boss.explain: 短文指出需要走路 thirty minutes (30分鐘)。Half an hour 即為半小時（30分鐘），故選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Green tea is known for its health benefits. It is consumed by millions of people in Asia to help digestion. 
Question: Why do many people drink green tea?
boss.explain: 文中提到「consumed ... to help digestion (飲用以幫助消化)」，assist with digestion 為同義替換，選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】To lose weight, you must burn more calories than you eat. This can be achieved by doing sports like running or swimming. 
Question: How can someone lose weight?
options: D. By using more energy than they consume.
boss.explain: 文中提到必須「burn more calories than you eat (消耗的卡路里要比吃進去的多)」，這等於 using more energy than they consume，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】The city has introduced electric buses to reduce air pollution. If more people use them, the air quality will improve significantly. 
Question: What is the purpose of the electric buses?
options: C. To make the air cleaner.
boss.explain: 引進電動公車是為了解決「air pollution (空氣污染)」並改善空氣品質，這與 To make the air cleaner 意義相同，故選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A new bicycle lane was built near the river. It allows people to ride safely without worrying about cars. 
Question: What is true about the new bicycle lane?
options: A. It keeps riders away from cars.
B. It is only for walking.
C. It is located near the mountain.
D. It was built five years ago.
boss.explain: 短文指出新車道讓騎士「without worrying about cars (不用擔心汽車)」，意即可以避開車輛 (keeps riders away from cars)，選 (A)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Traffic congestion is a major issue during rush hours. The government plans to build another subway line to solve this. 
Question: How will the government handle the heavy traffic?
options: B. By constructing a new train system.
boss.explain: 文中政府的解決方案是「build another subway line (建造另一條地鐵線)」，這與 constructing a new train system 意思一致，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果我們不現在採取行動，就會太遲了。
boss.ans: IF WE DO NOT ACT NOW IT WILL BE TOO LATE
boss.speak: if we do not act now it will be too late

boss.desc: 請唸出：這個提議已經被委員會拒絕了。
boss.ans: THE PROPOSAL HAS BEEN REJECTED BY THE COMMITTEE
boss.speak: the proposal has been rejected by the committee

boss.desc: 請唸出：雖然有風險，但我認為這是值得的。
boss.ans: ALTHOUGH THERE IS A RISK I THINK IT IS WORTH IT
boss.speak: although there is a risk i think it is worth it

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們必須確保客戶的抱怨得到妥善處理。
boss.ans: WE MUST ENSURE CUSTOMER COMPLAINTS ARE HANDLED WELL
boss.speak: we must ensure customer complaints are handled well

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果他們提出更好的條件，我們就接受。
boss.ans: IF THEY OFFER BETTER CONDITIONS WE WILL ACCEPT
boss.speak: if they offer better conditions we will accept

boss.desc: 請唸出：這幾個月來，我們已經取得了很大的進展。
boss.ans: WE HAVE MADE A LOT OF PROGRESS IN RECENT MONTHS
boss.speak: we have made a lot of progress in recent months

boss.desc: 請唸出：我很抱歉，但我無法同意這個解決方案。
boss.ans: I AM SORRY BUT I CANNOT AGREE WITH THIS SOLUTION
boss.speak: i am sorry but i cannot agree with this solution

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項計畫如果沒有你們的幫助就不會成功。
boss.ans: THE PROJECT WILL NOT SUCCEED WITHOUT YOUR HELP
boss.speak: the project will not succeed without your help

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們已經比較過所有的選項，這是最好的。
boss.ans: WE HAVE COMPARED ALL OPTIONS AND THIS IS THE BEST
boss.speak: we have compared all options and this is the best

boss.desc: 請唸出：新政策將在下個月由管理層實施。

boss.speak: the new policy will be implemented by management next month

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果預算被批准，我們將開始下一個階段。
boss.ans: IF THE BUDGET IS APPROVED WE WILL START THE NEXT PHASE
boss.speak: if the budget is approved we will start the next phase

boss.desc: 請唸出：這是我人生中做過最困難的決定。
